Comment: Station-performer NPC role: a minimal empty-brain Role modeled on the vanilla Empty_Role, carrying one Walk controller and one marked-target Seek instruction. Invulnerable, zero knockback, no DisplayNames (no nameplate), no InteractionInstruction (no F-prompt). The performer's model is a spawn parameter (not authored here), applied Java-side via NPCPlugin.spawnEntity's spawnModel plus a post-spawn PlayerSkinComponent clone.

MaxHealth.Description: Max health for the performer spike NPC
